items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: We had three saxes... Philip played lead alto sax and clarinet.

ctx.x: Do you remember his brother's name?

Yeah. Philip. Philip Salvaggio. And he was a very fine sax player. How many reads did he have in the band? We had three saxes. Three saxes. And we had trumpet and trombone and guitar, or banjo, and bass horn, and Joe on piano.
Who played tenor in the band?
